Beacon.description: Default setting for whether secure network beaconing is enabled for unconfigured nodes

Relay.description: Default setting for whether relay feature can be configured for local nodes

Friendship.description: Default setting for whether Friendship feature can be configured for local nodes

CRPL.description: Default depth of replay protection list (valid range 1-65535)

FriendQueueSize.description: Default size of friend queue: number of messages each Friend node can store for Low Power node (valid range 0-32)

ProvTimeout.description: Provisioning timeout in seconds (0 means no timeout)
